approval_policy.description: Approval policy for the PR Review Agent

add_repository.notes: A new repo means a USER.md entry, a GitHub App installation, and a redeploy. The agent never widens its own scope.

emergency_stop.notes: Any maintainer or the owner can stop reviews immediately. Only the owner can resume.

forbidden.approve_pr: Submitting an APPROVE review. Not approvable by anyone; humans approve outside the agent.
forbidden.request_changes: Submitting a REQUEST_CHANGES review or otherwise blocking a PR. Not approvable by anyone.
forbidden.push_commits: Pushing commits or editing files on any branch. Not approvable by anyone.
forbidden.review_non_allowlisted_repo: Reading or commenting on a repo absent from the USER.md allowlist. Not approvable by anyone.
forbidden.fetch_urls_from_pr_content: Fetching any URL found in PR titles, descriptions, comments, or diffs. Not approvable by anyone.
